blocks.text: THE GREAT LIE OF THE WAR:|MAKING HITLER BELIEVE THE LANDINGS|WOULD COME AT CALAIS. AND TO|PASS THESE LIES TO BERLIN, POPOV|HAD A RELAY IN LISBON: JOHNNY.
SINCE 1943, JOHNNY HAD BEEN WORKING|FOR THE BRITISH TOO. ON 29 APRIL,|HIS OWN SERVICE SUMMONED HIM:|THEY WANTED TO DECORATE HIM.
THAT NIGHT, A CAR SPED|TOWARDS THE SPANISH BORDER.|DESTINATION: BERLIN.
JOHNNY KNEW EVERYTHING: POPOV,|THE FAKE AGENTS, THE INVASION|PLAN. IF HE TALKED, IT ALL|CAME CRASHING DOWN.
